name: W7010 - Removable Media Governance
description: Intent: Warn-tier user dialog on Removable Media copy / move into the Unauthorized USB / removable-storage surface at sensitivity floor [2] — prompts the user before sensitive content is written to unsanctioned external media. Exclusions: excludes devices in USB_Authorized_Device_IDs_[is]; tune by populating with vendor/product IDs of every corporate-issued encrypted USB so legitimate copies don't warn users.
